violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports
violation_type.typical_finding: Information how parents to review a copy of the child-care home's most recent Licensing inspection report was not observed in the operational policies.

finding_variants.text: Information how parents to review a copy of the child-care home's most recent Licensing inspection report was not observed in the operational policies.
The operational policies were not available for review.
The section on how to access minimum standards is missing from the parent handbook.
The operational policies are missing instructions on how a parent may access the: (A) Minimum standards online; (C) HHSC website.
During inspection, operational policies did not state how parents can access Minimum Standards online, how to reach Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline and HHSC website.
Procedures for acessing minimum standards online, TX A/NN hotline, and the HHSC website were not listed in the operational policies.
